pr_title: drivers: pwm: stm32: add pwm capture support
pr_body:
Extends STM32 PWM driver to support capturing pulse width, period,
or both.

Fixes #39394

Signed-off-by: Tilmann Unte <unte@es-augsburg.de>
pr_comments:
Thank you for the feedback.
I didn't intend for this to be a bother to review, my apologies.

I'll see to it that I can split things up into multiple commits.

It took me a few attempts, but I believe I  have now integrated the required changes:

- Commits are split according to files/changes
- Commit messages are more detailed
- Style changes in driver code have been removed for now
- Overlay file got a copyright notice and newline at the end
- Fixed an oversight on the DT compatible, as I was using an outdated version

HW tests are passing on my end, but I need to highlight that I only have a single board to test on.
^^ @str4t0m you may be interested, and your review would be welcome
This issue caused by me, this link https://github.com/multiwii/baseflight/blob/master/src/drv_pwm.c maybe helpful

> this link https://github.com/multiwii/baseflight/blob/master/src/drv_pwm.c maybe helpful

I had not seen this before. Unfortunately it does not help much as a reference, because it uses the HAL library, whereas the Zephyr driver exclusively uses LL.

I personally prefer LL, because it has a close relationship to the hardware registers defined in the reference manuals.
I've worked on the requested changes, but will continue to test locally
BTW, I tested on nucleo_f207zg, and it works fine.

> No related CI failure: tests/kernel/lifo/lifo_usage/kernel.lifo.usage in qemu_cortex_a53_smp:tests/kernel/lifo/lifo_usage/kernel.lifo

Anything I can/need to do here?

> > No related CI failure: tests/kernel/lifo/lifo_usage/kernel.lifo.usage in qemu_cortex_a53_smp:tests/kernel/lifo/lifo_usage/kernel.lifo

> Anything I can/need to do here?

You can have a try to rebase on very latest master, hopefully the issue got fixed.
